question: At which BIMSTEC Summit was the agreement to set up the Technology Transfer Facility in Colombo signed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fifth Summit**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The agreement to set up the BIMSTEC Technology Transfer Facility (TTF) in Colombo, Sri Lanka, was signed during the **Fifth BIMSTEC Summit** held on **30 March 2022**.
 
• The summit was chaired by **Sri Lanka**, and it was held virtually due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• The Technology Transfer Facility aims to **strengthen cooperation among BIMSTEC member countries** in the field of technology, innovation, and capacity building.
 
• This initiative focuses on **sharing technologies and innovations** to promote sustainable development and boost regional economic growth.
 
• The Fifth Summit also adopted the **BIMSTEC Charter**, which provides a formal structure for the organization and enhances its institutional framework.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Third BIMSTEC Summit**:
 
 
• The Third BIMSTEC Summit was held in **Nay Pyi Taw, Myanmar, on 4 March 2014**.
 
• The summit emphasized enhanced connectivity among member nations, including road, rail, and air links.
 
• It also highlighted the importance of energy cooperation and trade facilitation.
 
 
 
• **Fourth BIMSTEC Summit**:
 
 
• The Fourth BIMSTEC Summit took place in **Kathmandu, Nepal, on 30-31 August 2018**.
 
• The focus was on deepening regional integration and connectivity, including the signing of the **BIMSTEC Convention on Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters**.
 
• Leaders emphasized the need for a Free Trade Agreement (FTA) to strengthen economic cooperation.
 
 
 
• **Sixth BIMSTEC Summit**:
 
 
• The Sixth BIMSTEC Summit is yet to take place as of October 2023.
 
• It is expected to build upon the initiatives undertaken during the Fifth Summit, particularly in areas of technology, connectivity, and economic cooperation.
 
 
 
• **BIMSTEC Overview**:
 
 
• BIMSTEC stands for the **Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation**.
 
• It includes seven member states: Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, and Thailand.
 
• The organization aims to promote regional cooperation in areas such as trade, technology, energy, transport, and climate change.
